brief:
Farmers in Gaza have undertaken efforts to reconstruct a local seed bank that was destroyed during Israel's military operations in the enclave, according to Al-Monitor. The project centers on preserving native crop varieties adapted to Gaza's specific growing conditions and encouraging Palestinian cultivators to maximize yields on the limited arable land remaining available to them.

The initiative reflects broader attempts to restore agricultural capacity in Gaza following widespread devastation. By recovering traditional seeds suited to local soil and climate, farmers aim to strengthen food production and maintain farming practices that have sustained Palestinian communities for generations.

title: Gaza farmers rebuild seed bank destroyed in Israeli war
